localCustodian.scope: Official municipal pages identify the responsible urbanistic/cadastral-services sector and public map/Geoportale access; the municipal map is a general city map, while planning Geoportale content is not itself a cadastral parcel API.

nationalService.name: Agenzia delle Entrate - Cartografia catastale

attempts.request: GET Comune di Padova official city-map page
attempts.outcome: HTTP content returned; public municipal map identified. Page describes filters for city services and toponymy, not a direct parcel feature endpoint.

attempts.request: GET Comune di Padova PAT page
attempts.outcome: HTTP content returned; official Geoportale/webgis and Settore Urbanistica e Servizi Catastali identified. Planning layers and requested shapefiles are described; no direct parcel API was exposed in page text.
Success. CP:CadastralParcel (Particelle) identified; default CRS EPSG:6706; GML output formats; service describes national parcel coverage.

attempts.request: GET WFS bounded GetFeature GeoJSON variant
attempts.outcome: HTTP response was a WFS ServiceException InvalidFormat because this endpoint advertises GML/HTML formats, not GeoJSON; not treated as absence.

attempts.request: GET WFS bounded GetFeature GML variant, Padua point vicinity
attempts.outcome: Success; returned three parcel polygons in GML, numberReturned=3, timestamp 2026-10-12T01:49:12Z.

boundedProbe.bboxCrs: EPSG:6706; service response uses latitude,longitude axis order
boundedProbe.exactPointInterpretation: WUP point preserved unchanged; bounded vicinity probe is not a citywide coverage claim or an exact-point intersection claim.

sourceReview.identityMapping: Retained GeoJSON properties contain only id=INSPIREID_LOCALID. Source field mapping and provenance are documented here; no synthetic row number used.

limitations: The three-feature sample is a bounded probe, not citywide coverage or adapter admission.
The municipal pages establish local custodianship and public GIS/planning access, but no direct municipal parcel API was validated.
The WFS response is GML in EPSG:6706 latitude/longitude axis order; retained GeoJSON uses standard longitude/latitude coordinate order.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe cadastral/person fields were used.
The initial GeoJSON-format failure is a format limitation, not evidence of absence.
